1336.104.1.description:
storm-protection enable/disable

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the storm-protection enable/disable control. Configures storm-protection on an ingress port, drives a broadcast/traffic storm and confirms the port is err-disabled when protection is active, then confirms the port stays up once storm-protection is disabled. Restores and re-verifies config.

1336.104.2.description:
Storm-rate command

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the storm-rate threshold command. Confirms the port is err-disabled when traffic exceeds the configured storm-rate, and that the port is left up when the transmit rate stays below the rate. Restores and re-verifies config.

1336.104.3.description:
Storm-window command

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the storm-window command. Confirms storm-protection triggers (port err-disabled) only when the offending traffic rate is sustained across the configured measurement window. Restores and re-verifies config.

1336.104.4.description:
storm-downtime command - 1 second

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the storm-downtime command. After storm-protection disables the port, measures the interval between the port-down and port-up log events and confirms it matches the configured downtime before the port is automatically re-enabled. Restores and re-verifies config.

1336.104.5.description:
storm-downtime command - 10 seconds

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the storm-downtime command. After storm-protection disables the port, measures the interval between the port-down and port-up log events and confirms it matches the configured downtime before the port is automatically re-enabled. Restores and re-verifies config.

1336.104.6.description:
storm-action command - port disable, ingress port on stack master

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the storm-action port-disable behaviour. Drives repeated storm cycles and confirms that on storm detection the ingress port is placed in the Disabled state (and only that port), recovering between cycles. The ingress port resides on the stack Active Master. Restores and re-verifies config.

1336.104.7.description:
storm-protection - linkdown, ingress port on stack master

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the storm-protection linkdown action. Drives repeated storm cycles and confirms storm-protection is triggered the expected number of times, taking the ingress link down on each detection. The ingress port resides on the stack Active Master. Restores and re-verifies config.

1336.104.8.description:
storm-action command - vlan disable

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the storm-action vlan-disable behaviour. Drives repeated storm cycles and confirms that when a storm is detected the offending VLAN is disabled on the ingress port (port shown Disabled) so the storm traffic is blocked, recovering between cycles. Restores and re-verifies config.

1336.104.9.description:
storm-action command - vlan disable, ingress port on stack master

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the storm-action vlan-disable behaviour. Drives repeated storm cycles and confirms that when a storm is detected the offending VLAN is disabled on the ingress port (port shown Disabled) so the storm traffic is blocked, recovering between cycles. The ingress port resides on the stack Active Master. Restores and re-verifies config.

1336.104.60.description:
storm-action command - port disable, ingress port on stack backup member

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the storm-action port-disable behaviour. Drives repeated storm cycles and confirms that on storm detection the ingress port is placed in the Disabled state (and only that port), recovering between cycles. The ingress port resides on a stack backup member to exercise the cross-member path. Restores and re-verifies config.

1336.104.70.description:
storm-protection - linkdown, ingress port on stack backup member

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the storm-protection linkdown action.
